stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Billy is one of Wanda's twin sons on Earth-838, and she raises him with love. When the Scarlet Witch comes for the boys, Wanda throws herself between them.
stages.whoA: Her son, Tommy's twin.
stages.whoB: His mother, who shields him from the Scarlet Witch.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Tommy is the other of Wanda's twin sons on Earth-838. When the Scarlet Witch steps out of a portal to take the boys, Wanda fights to protect him and his brother.
stages.whoA: Her son, Billy's twin.
stages.whoB: His mother, who fights to protect him and Billy.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Billy and Tommy are twin brothers who share a home with their mother on Earth-838. When the Scarlet Witch comes for them, they run and hide together.
stages.whoA: His twin brother.
stages.whoB: His twin brother.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: This Wanda is the Scarlet Witch's other self on Earth-838, living the life with Billy and Tommy that the Scarlet Witch longs for. The Scarlet Witch dreamwalks into her body to hunt America Chavez and kills the Illuminati with it. When she finally comes for the boys in person, this Wanda shields them, then gently tells her they will be loved.
stages.whoA: Her Earth-838 self, whose body she steals and who comforts her at the end.
stages.whoB: The Scarlet Witch, her other self, who hijacks her body to reach her sons.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Wanda dreams of these boys as the sons she lost, and dreamwalks into their mother's body to spend time with them. When she comes for them in person, Billy hides from her in terror, and seeing the boys' fear, she finally lets them go.
stages.whoA: The Earth-838 Billy, the son she longs for, who is terrified of her.
stages.whoB: The Scarlet Witch, his mother's double, who comes to take him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Wanda dreams of these boys as her own sons, and while dreamwalking in their mother she listens to Tommy and Billy sing for ice cream. When she comes for them in person, Tommy screams that she is a witch, and their fear makes her let them go.
stages.whoA: The Earth-838 Tommy, the son she longs for, who calls her a witch.
stages.whoB: The Scarlet Witch, who looks like his mother and comes to take him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: When the Scarlet Witch possesses the Wanda of his world, Charles enters her mind and finds this Wanda trapped beneath rubble. He reaches out to pull her free and break the spell, but the Scarlet Witch kills him before he can.
stages.whoA: The Wanda of his world, whom he dies trying to free.
stages.whoB: Charles Xavier, who dies trying to free her from the Scarlet Witch.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Dreamwalking in the Wanda of Earth-838, the Scarlet Witch breaks into the Illuminati's base, and Captain Carter fights her beside Captain Marvel. Wanda catches her thrown shield and sends it back, cutting her in half.
stages.whoA: The Scarlet Witch, who kills her with her own shield.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Captain Carter, whom she kills with her own shield.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Maria scoffs that the Illuminati can handle the Scarlet Witch, then faces her when she breaks into their base. As Captain Marvel she nearly overpowers her, but Wanda crushes her under a falling statue.
stages.whoA: The Scarlet Witch, whom she nearly beats before being crushed.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Captain Marvel, whom she crushes under a statue after a hard fight.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Black Bolt stands with the Illuminati against the Scarlet Witch, and Reed warns her that he could destroy her with a whisper. Wanda simply erases his mouth, and his own trapped scream kills him.
stages.whoA: The Scarlet Witch, who erases his mouth so his own voice kills him.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Black Bolt, whose mouth she erases so his scream kills him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Reed faces the Scarlet Witch at the Illuminati's base and begs her, as a fellow parent, to let the Wanda she has possessed go. She asks whether his children's mother is alive, says someone will be left to raise them, and tears him apart.
stages.whoA: The Scarlet Witch, who tears him apart when he pleads as a father.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Reed Richards, who pleads with her as a father before she kills him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Charles arrives after the Scarlet Witch has killed the rest of the Illuminati and enters the mind of the possessed Wanda to free her. The Scarlet Witch finds him there and snaps his neck, which kills him.
stages.whoA: The Scarlet Witch, who snaps his neck when he enters her mind.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Charles Xavier, who invades her mind until she snaps his neck.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Captain Carter sits on the Illuminati council that holds the visiting Stephen as a danger to their world. She tells him his other self created the Illuminati, and that they made their hard choice knowing what their Strange, and perhaps every Strange, was capable of.
stages.whoA: Another Strange, whom her council holds as a threat.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Captain Carter, one of the Illuminati who judge him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Maria sits on the Illuminati council that judges the visiting Stephen. When he warns them about the Scarlet Witch, she brushes him off and says they can handle her.
stages.whoA: Another Strange, judged by her council, whose warning she brushes off.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Captain Marvel, a judge who brushes off his warning.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Black Bolt sits silently on the Illuminati council that judges the visiting Stephen, who mocks his name. In Charles's memory, Stephen watches him execute this world's Strange.
stages.whoA: Another Strange, who mocks his name as the council judges him.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Black Bolt, the silent judge who executed his other self.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Reed warns the visiting Stephen that his presence could cause an incursion, and tells him the greatest danger to the multiverse is Doctor Strange. He recounts how their own Strange confessed to destroying a universe.
stages.whoA: Another Strange, whom he calls the multiverse's greatest danger.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Reed Richards, who calls him the multiverse's greatest danger.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Charles shows the visiting Stephen the memory of how the Illuminati executed their own Strange. Of all his judges he is the one who still hopes this Stephen can be better, though he leaves him under guard to face the Scarlet Witch.
stages.whoA: Another Strange, whom he judges but still hopes is better.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Charles Xavier, the judge who still sees good in him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Earth-838's Mordo greets Stephen as a brother, then drugs his tea and hands him to the Illuminati. When the Scarlet Witch kills the others, Mordo tries to kill Stephen himself, and Stephen tricks him into breaking his cuffs and escapes.
stages.whoA: Another Strange, whom he drugs, imprisons and tries to kill.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Mordo, who drugs him, jails him and tries to kill him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Mordo welcomes America and Stephen into his Sanctum, then drugs their tea and locks them up for the Illuminati. He tells them it is the two of them, not Wanda, who threaten his world.
stages.whoA: The girl he drugs and locks up as a threat to his world.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Mordo, who drugs her and locks her up.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Mordo and Charles sit together on the Illuminati council. When the Scarlet Witch attacks, they stay behind with Stephen, and Mordo insists he cannot be trusted while Charles hopes he is better than his other self.
stages.whoA: A fellow Illuminati member, who sees good where he sees danger.
stages.whoB: Mordo, a fellow Illuminati member who distrusts the visiting Strange.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Captain Carter and Captain Marvel sit together on the Illuminati council. When the Scarlet Witch kills Black Bolt and Reed, the two fight her side by side, and both die in the attempt.
stages.whoA: Captain Marvel, who fights the Scarlet Witch at her side.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, who fights the Scarlet Witch at her side.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Captain Carter and Black Bolt are fellow members of the Illuminati. She tells the visiting Stephen to be grateful that Black Bolt does not talk to him, and the two face the Scarlet Witch together.
stages.whoA: A fellow Illuminati member, whose silence she tells Strange to be grateful for.
stages.whoB: Captain Carter, a fellow Illuminati member who faces the Scarlet Witch with him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Reed and Black Bolt sit together on the Illuminati council and confront the Scarlet Witch side by side. Reed warns her that Black Bolt can destroy her with one whisper, and she kills Black Bolt and then Reed.
stages.whoA: A fellow Illuminati member, whose deadly voice he holds over the Scarlet Witch.
stages.whoB: Reed Richards, a fellow Illuminati member who dies beside him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Black Bolt serves on the Illuminati that Strange created. When Strange confesses to destroying a universe, Black Bolt carries out his execution, whispering that he is sorry.
stages.whoA: A fellow Illuminati member, who executes him.
stages.whoB: The Illuminati's founder, whom he executes with a whispered apology.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Reed calls this Strange their friend, a fellow member of the Illuminati. He recounts how Strange gathered them one night and confessed that his dreamwalking had destroyed a universe.
stages.whoA: A friend on the Illuminati, to whom he confesses destroying a universe.
stages.whoB: Their friend and the Illuminati's founder, who confessed to destroying a universe.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Captain Carter serves on the Illuminati that this Strange created to make the hard decisions no one else could. After his execution, she helps hide how he really died.
stages.whoA: A fellow Illuminati member, who helps hide how he died.
stages.whoB: The Illuminati's founder, whose death she helps hide.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Charles serves on the Illuminati beside this Strange and says that while the rest of them banded together against Thanos, Strange went it alone. He keeps the memory of Strange's execution and shows it to another Stephen.
stages.whoA: A fellow Illuminati member, who keeps the memory of his death.
stages.whoB: The Illuminati's founder, who went it alone and was executed for it.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Mordo calls this Strange his brother. After Strange's execution, Mordo takes his place as Sorcerer Supreme and on the Illuminati, and the other Stephen accuses him of having been jealous of him.
stages.whoA: Mordo, who calls him his brother and takes his place.
stages.whoB: His brother, whose place as Sorcerer Supreme he takes.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Christine and this Strange were close, though she says they never quite figured out what they were. She blames him for an incursion that killed a trillion people, and she volunteered to work for the Illuminati at his funeral.
stages.whoA: Christine, who never quite figured out what they were to each other.
stages.whoB: Her Stephen, who killed a trillion people. They never figured out what they were.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Earth-838's Christine holds the visiting Stephen for testing and keeps him at arm's length, since her own Stephen's choices killed a trillion people. When the Scarlet Witch attacks, she leads him to the Book of Vishanti and guards his body while he dreamwalks. Before she goes home, he tells her he loves her in every universe.
stages.whoA: Another Stephen. She distrusts him, then saves him, and hears he loves her.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Christine, who saves his life. He tells her he loves her.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Christine holds America for testing, then tries to free her from her cell when the Scarlet Witch attacks, and they escape together. Later America finds her and sends her home through a portal.
stages.whoA: The girl she holds for testing, then frees and escapes with.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Christine, who frees her from her cell and escapes with her.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: The Scarlet Witch breaks into the base where Christine holds America and chases them through its tunnels. At the Book of Vishanti she throws Christine and Stephen into a dying universe.
stages.whoA: The Scarlet Witch, who hunts her and throws her into a dying universe.
stages.whoB: Earth-838's Christine, whom she throws into a dying universe.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Defender Strange takes America under his protection when a demon hunts her across the multiverse, and she comes to count him as a friend. Together they race through the space between universes toward the Book of Vishanti.
stages.whoA: A girl who can cross universes, whom he protects.
stages.whoB: Another Strange, who protects her and becomes her friend.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: When the demon corners them, he decides her power is safer with him and begins drawing it out, which would kill her. The demon impales him first, and he dies after her portal throws them both into another universe.
stages.whoA: His friend, whose power he tries to take even if it kills her.
stages.whoB: The friend who betrays her and tries to take her power.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Dogpool, whose name is Mary Puppins, is Nicepool's dog in the Void, and she keeps running off from him. He follows her into Wade's world, where he is killed, and Wade takes her home.
stages.whoA: His dog, Mary Puppins, who keeps running off.
stages.whoB: Her owner in the Void, until he is killed.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Nicepool is a Deadpool with no scars, and he is so cheerful that Wade can hardly stand him, though he lends Wade and Logan his minivan in the Void. When the Deadpool variants attack in Wade's world, Wade uses him as a shield, not knowing he cannot heal, and he is killed.
stages.whoA: Another Deadpool, who uses him as a human shield and gets him killed.
stages.whoB: A nicer Deadpool he can't stand, whom he gets killed as a shield.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Nicepool lends Logan and Wade his minivan in the Void, and later warns them about the Deadpool variants coming for them. Logan is disgusted when Wade gets him killed by using him as a shield.
stages.whoA: A Logan he helps in the Void and warns about the variants.
stages.whoB: A cheerful Deadpool, whose death as Wade's shield disgusts him.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Nicepool knows Ladypool from the Void and gushes about her to Wade. When she arrives with the Deadpool variants Cassandra Nova summons, they open fire, and he is killed.
stages.whoA: A Deadpool he admires, whose crew guns him down.
stages.whoB: A Deadpool she knows from the Void, killed when her crew opens fire.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Ladypool comes with the Deadpool variants Cassandra Nova summons to stall Wade. They trade jokes about the multiverse before the shooting starts, and the fight only stops when Peter arrives.
stages.whoA: Deadpool Prime, whom Cassandra Nova sends her to stop.
stages.whoB: A Deadpool variant who comes to stop him for Cassandra Nova.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Ladypool fights Logan in the brawl with the Deadpool variants, and he cuts her down. She heals in moments and is back on her feet when Peter arrives.
stages.whoA: The Logan who cuts her down in the brawl.
stages.whoB: A lady Deadpool he cuts down, who heals in moments.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Ladypool is among the Deadpool variants who come at Cassandra Nova's call to stall Wade and Logan while she reaches the Time Ripper.
stages.whoA: The ruler of the Void, who sends her after Wade and Logan.
stages.whoB: A Deadpool variant she sends to stall Wade and Logan.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Catherine is Alex's mother, and she hides her part in PRIDE's killings from him. When he exposes PRIDE and runs, she hunts for him, until he plants a gun in her car and gets her and Geoffrey arrested.
stages.whoA: Her son, who exposes PRIDE and gets her arrested.
stages.whoB: His mother, a PRIDE killer whom he exposes and sends to jail.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: In prison, Catherine tells Alex she is sorry for her crimes and that she loves him, but he refuses to forgive her and walks away. She is murdered soon after, and the news leaves him broken with guilt.
stages.whoA: Her son, who rejects her apology before she is killed.
stages.whoB: His mother, who apologizes from prison and is murdered.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Catherine and Geoffrey are married and search for Alex together through PRIDE. When she secretly kills Darius, whom Geoffrey trusted, they fight bitterly, but they stand together until both are arrested.
stages.whoA: Her husband and partner in PRIDE.
stages.whoB: His wife and partner in PRIDE, who kills his friend Darius.

stages.title: Runaways S3
stages.text: Catherine confesses to killing Darius so that Geoffrey can go free, and asks him to wait for her. She is killed in prison soon after, which devastates him.
stages.whoA: Her husband, whom she frees by confessing.
stages.whoB: His wife, who takes the blame to free him and dies in prison.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Darius has worked with Geoffrey for years, but Catherine sees him only as a threat to her family. She frames him for Destiny Gonzalez's murder and shoots him dead to clear the Runaways.
stages.whoA: Geoffrey's old associate, whom she frames and kills.
stages.whoB: Geoffrey's wife, who frames him for murder and shoots him.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Catherine suspects Molly saw one of PRIDE's sacrifices and questions her. She then plots with the Yorkes to send Molly away to keep her quiet.
stages.whoA: A girl she suspects saw PRIDE kill, and plots to send away.
stages.whoB: Alex's mother, who questions her and plots to send her away.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Catherine and the Yorkes serve in PRIDE together. When Molly may have seen a sacrifice, they plot together to send her away, until Jonah finds out.
stages.whoA: Fellow PRIDE members, with whom she plots to send Molly away.
stages.whoB: A fellow PRIDE member, who plots with them to send Molly away.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Catherine and Tina run PRIDE's affairs side by side. Catherine resents Tina acting as its only leader, and is upset when Tina kills a reporter to silence her.
stages.whoA: A fellow PRIDE member, whose leadership she resents.
stages.whoB: A fellow PRIDE member, who resents her taking the lead.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Catherine takes part in the sacrifices that keep Jonah alive. When he threatens her and Geoffrey over Karolina, she vows to have nothing more to do with him, and later hopes aloud that he dies.
stages.whoA: The man PRIDE kills for, whom she comes to defy.
stages.whoB: A PRIDE member who serves him, then turns against him.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: When Livvie's alibi for Darius threatens to reopen the case, Catherine has AWOL, a corrupt cop, destroy the evidence and attack Livvie's family to frighten her.
stages.whoA: A corrupt cop she sends after Livvie.
stages.whoB: The lawyer who orders him to frighten Livvie's family.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frank raises Karolina as his own daughter, though Jonah is her real father. When she tells him the truth about PRIDE, he passes it on to Jonah, insisting that he is still the one who raised her.
stages.whoA: His daughter, whom he raised though Jonah is her real father.
stages.whoB: The father who raised her, though Jonah is her real one.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Ruling the Church of Gibborim, Frank locks Karolina in a cell in the Crater when she comes for her mother. Her light turns his followers against him, and they lock him away instead.
stages.whoA: His daughter, whom he locks up to keep his church.
stages.whoB: The father who locks her up, until her light ends his rule.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Frank is married to Leslie, the leader of the Church of Gibborim, and his fame helps make it known. He learns she has had a long affair with Jonah and that his memory of it was wiped.
stages.whoA: His wife, who hid her affair with Jonah and wiped his memory.
stages.whoB: Her husband, the actor who fronts her church.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: The two unite against Jonah for a time, but when Leslie moves to shut the church down, Frank has her held in the Crater. She escapes with Karolina's help.
stages.whoA: His wife, whom he imprisons to keep the church.
stages.whoB: Her husband, who imprisons her in the Crater to keep her church.

stages.title: Runaways S1–S2
stages.text: Jonah wins Frank over with healing gloves and a rising place in the church, and Frank tells him the Runaways' plans. When Jonah demands that he find a teen to sacrifice, Frank refuses.
stages.whoA: His wife's lover, who empowers him and then demands a sacrifice.
stages.whoB: Leslie's husband, whom he props up in the church and uses.
